# Mohannad Shafik (MS Portfolio)

> Mohannad Shafik is a full-stack developer from Turnhout, Belgium, working on AI and automation. He builds complete systems in Python and TypeScript (API, database, dashboard, Claude API integration) and is looking for a first role as a junior developer. This site (msportfolio.be, also written "MS Portfolio") is his portfolio, in Dutch and English. Each project states what was measured and what has not been done yet.

Contact: mohannadshafik@msportfolio.be · GitHub: https://github.com/Ms-8888 · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mohannad-shafik/

## English
- [Home](https://msportfolio.be/en/): profile, selected projects, education and skills
- [Projects](https://msportfolio.be/en/projects/): six projects, five with open code and one private
- [Webhook platform](https://msportfolio.be/en/projects/webhook-platform/): signed webhook delivery with automatic retries and a dashboard (FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, React)
- [Knowledge assistant](https://msportfolio.be/en/projects/knowledge-assistant/): Dutch Q&A over company documents with cited sources and an honest "I don't know" (FastAPI, pgvector)
- [Data quality tool](https://msportfolio.be/en/projects/data-quality/): finds bad emails, duplicates and company-name variants in CSV/Excel and applies only what the user approves
- [How I work](https://msportfolio.be/en/how-i-work/): building with an AI assistant without trusting it blindly
- [CV](https://msportfolio.be/en/cv/): one-page CV as PDF, Dutch and English
- [Contact](https://msportfolio.be/en/contact/)
